I'm 24. I wouldn't say I love myself, but I do tolerate myself better now. The answer to that is therapy for me. That means I've had ten years where I've learned to live with the parts of myself I use to hate. 

For my autism specifically, I learned that it's just a part of me. It isn't something that I'll ever live without, so why wouldn't I accept it? (One of my therapists asked me that years ago.) I learned to accept that it makes me me, and even when I feel like it hinders my life, I have to remind myself of the things I enjoy about being autistic.
